divergences.description: Spec 6.2 says to insert the CONVERSAS section between the pinned `_DrawerPrimaryAction` ("Novo Chat") and the nav-item container. In the code, "Novo Chat" moved inside `_ConversasSection`, below the CONVERSAS label, inside a scrollable area. The section only renders when the state is `ChatReady`, so "Novo Chat" is now hidden while bootstrap is loading or has failed. Before this change it was always visible.
Spec 6.2 Boundaries say "no new design tokens", but the code adds the new token `DesignTokens.drawerSessionItemGap` for the gap between a session row's title and its timestamp.
The "Meus Registros" drawer icon changed from `Icons.menu_book_outlined` to `Icons.note_outlined`. No plan asks for this; it is a visual product change outside the story scope.

Spec 6.1 says the failure indicator (`colorError`/`colorErrorBg`) replaces the timestamp slot when a message fails, and spec 6.3 says the retry copy replaces that indicator. In the code, every bubble gets a new timestamp caption that is always shown ("agora" or HH:mm). The retry copy is rendered above that caption instead of replacing it, and no `colorErrorBg` band is used.

It also adds `debugPrint` diagnostics. None of these transport changes are in the plan, which only asks for a `ResponseType.stream` method that reuses the existing error mapping.

The failed-bubble indicator differs from spec 6-1. The plan says the indicator uses colorError/colorErrorBg and replaces the timestamp slot. The diff never uses colorErrorBg, always renders a timestamp caption (with an 'agora' placeholder and a new ChatUiMessage.createdAt field), and puts the retry copy above the timestamp instead of in its place.

ApiClient.postStream changes transport behaviour beyond the plan. It sets receiveTimeout to Duration.zero, which turns off the client-side receive timeout for streams, and persistentConnection to false, so every send/retry opens a fresh connection. It also adds debugPrint diagnostics. The plan only asked for a ResponseType.stream method that reuses the existing error mapping.

ChatCubit.sendMessage and retryMessage now refuse to run while ChatReady.isOffline is true. Spec 6-3 only planned isOffline as a UI gate for the composer, banner and 'Novo Chat'. This cubit-level guard also turns a failed bubble's retry tap into a no-op while offline.
